items.source:
fn required_number<T>(tokens: &mut LinoTokens<'_>, name: &str) -> Result<T, String>
where
    T: std::str::FromStr,
    T::Err: std::fmt::Display,
{
    required_atom(tokens, name)?
        .parse::<T>()
        .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
}
